macros.name: Numstr
macros.doc: Formats a number or a TeX count register in the range of 0 to 999,999,999 as words, where the first letter is a capital letter.

macros.name: ordstr
macros.doc: Formats a number or a TeX count register in the range of 0 to 999,999,999 as an ordinal word.

macros.name: Ordstr
macros.doc: Formats a number or a TeX count register in the range of 0 to 999,999,999 as an ordinal word, where the first letter is a capital letter.

macros.name: ordstring
macros.doc: Formats a LaTeX counter in the range of 0 to 999,999,999 as an ordinal word.
